

```{r}
#decision tree model
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

```
```{r}
load("heart_disease_split.RData")
load("heart_disease_cleaned.RData")
```

```{r}

### Make sure the target is a factor  

hd_training$target <- as.factor(hd_training$target)
hd_testing$target  <- as.factor(hd_testing$target)

```
```{r}
#using clean/split data
dt_model <- rpart(
  target ~ .,
  data = hd_training,
  method = "class"
)
```
```{r}
#plot the tree
# plot the tree with white → red scale
rpart.plot(
  dt_model,
  type = 2,
  extra = 104,
  box.palette = c("white", "red"),  # white → deep red
  shadow.col = "gray",
  nn = TRUE
)

```
